desc: Prove that bottleneck distances equal the first edge threshold at which two vertices become connected.
Prove the component invariant that all internally feasible opposite-type occurrences are matched optimally, leaving only a signed residual imbalance.
Implement DSU initialization from multiplicities in sequences A and B and accumulate newly formed matches using 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
Handle equal-weight edges safely and justify that arbitrary ordering within one weight gives the same total.
Provide efficient input parsing, edge sorting, and final Python solution output.
